intelligence.essence: MOBILE: the cover goes on the top of the mobile and fits there; the button to go next goes below it; the frame fits around — one design, fits both screens. LOGIN: the portal page is the login; then the membership area; then they access any videos, audios or text in a beautiful presentation — click, click, click through it all. DEEPER LINKS: below the frame, links for going deeper — click one and it opens text-by-text blocks in elevated blocks, same format as Naya notes / Smart Notes, more perspectives, what's in it for you, why it matters, what it is ultimately, child/grandma clarity. BUTTONS: buttons at the bottom for more information — a matrix-like look; the citizen chooses whatever level they want to see. THREE FORMATS: every subject is a lesson in three formats — AUDIO (PowerCast player as one of the frames), VIDEO (frame harvested from the collective agreement), TEXT (frame harvested). "We already have it built. We're just going to take what we have and put it there." SMART ACCESS BEHIND A PAYWALL: membership is not just membership — smart access behind a paywall; with Naya Max, a citizen builds products behind a paywall with the portal entrance. STRUCTURE: the course is the beginning hub; the lessons are the branches off the hub; the content is the formats of those branches. Plus the one extra board: a button board with the table of contents to the different areas of the course.
